prose:
Techmeme attributes to Alexandr Wang the view that a reported Riemann Hypothesis proof signals that AI will exceed human performance in every field, including AI research, alongside a call for safety and alignment. That is a broad extrapolation from a claimed mathematical development, not evidence that the extrapolation is already true.

The supplied link opens Wang's profile rather than a specific dated statement; the retrieved profile text did not expose the cited post. The argument is therefore summarized only from the feed excerpt. Neither the proof's correctness and acceptance nor the claimed generality was independently established here. This statement must remain distinct from the Masullo formalization dashboard, the Alpöge commentary and the earlier hypothetical interview video.
highlights: The statement is attributed to Wang by Techmeme
It extrapolates from a reported mathematical claim to all fields
It also calls for safety and alignment
The source URL is a profile, not a resolved individual post
Retrieved profile content did not contain the cited statement
Proof acceptance and cross-domain generality remain unverified
